# Boulangerie Imaginaire (fictional demo site)

> A FICTIONAL sourdough bakery, built on purpose to score as badly as possible on Google PageSpeed Insights,
> for a class on web performance, SEO and GEO (AI search). The bakery, address, phone and people do not exist.
> Source: https://github.com/maelstromcoder/bad-website-4-pagespeed.web.dev

## Pages you may read

- [Home](/home): the bakery, its four breads, and a newsletter form.
- [Menu](/menu): the four breads with descriptions.

## What you will NOT be able to read (on purpose)

- Opening hours and two prices exist only inside a picture (/assets/img/hours-board.png) with no alt text.
- Today's specials and all menu prices are written in by JavaScript after the page loads.
- /secret-recipes is blocked for AI crawlers in robots.txt.
- /members is blocked for every crawler in robots.txt.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](/robots.txt)
- [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml)
